description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing 'Unit' entities within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, deleting units, and managing unit conversions, with methods handling HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Unit
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing units and their conversions within the Coocook project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list units, their usage, and conversions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a unit by ID for subsequent actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific unit, including its articles, conversions, and related units.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new unit and redirects to update or insert.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing unit.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Performs the actual update or insertion of a unit, with validation.

methods.name: add_conversion
methods.description: Adds a new conversion between units.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the appropriate page after actions.
